note: The setup is in Maxwell.Free.erasing (fixed family with vanishing Ward sums, weight-four rise), the form b_x is bond G x 0 on shellSector G 4, and the Kelvin/Wick identity is Maxwell.Free.corridor, used through low_motion. Difference: the weight-four space is the Wick-polynomial shell sector and the comparison is written with the rotation reflectPol (house y * house x).

snippet.text:
theorem erasing (h : G.Simple) : erases (hierarchy F).spin (scheme F) := by
  refine ⟨4,?_⟩
  intro d hd T H W
  let P u v := brand F (d:=d) (T u v)
  let R := (scheme F).rise hd
  have hw u v : silence G d (P u v) := (branded F _).mp (fun n w x hx => W n x hx u v w)
  have ht (u v) (p : (Model F).Field 4) : T u v (R p)∈LinearMap.range R := H.rises _ hd u v p

proof_context.conclusion: erasing fixes the family T u v with all Ward sums vanishing (silence of the branded P u v) and the weight-four rise R.

lemma corridor (h : G.Simple) {x y : E4} (hx : x≠0) (hy : y≠0) (he : ‖x‖=‖y‖) (p q : WickPol G)
    (hp : p ∈ shellSector G 4) (hq : q ∈ shellSector G 4) :
    bond G x 0 p q=bond G y 0 (reflectPol (house y * house x) p) q := by
  have H : ∀ p∈Floor G,∀ q∈Floor G, bond G x 0 (reflectPol (house x) p) q=bond G y 0 (reflectPol (house y) p) q := by
    intro p hp; induction hp using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem u h =>
      obtain ⟨p,rfl⟩ := h
      intro v hv; induction hv using Submodule.span_induction with
      | mem v h => obtain ⟨q,rfl⟩ := h; exact bond_rotate_same_list p q hx hy he
      | zero => simp
      | add p q _ _ h k => rw [map_add,map_add,h,k]
      | smul c p _ h => rw [map_smul,map_smul,h]
    | zero => simp
    | add p q _ _ h k => intro u hu; rw [map_add,map_add,map_add,map_add,LinearMap.add_apply,LinearMap.add_apply,h u hu,k u hu]
    | smul t p _ h => intro u hu; rw [map_smul,map_smul,map_smul,map_smul,LinearMap.smul_apply,LinearMap.smul_apply,h u hu]
  have hr := H _ (fits_floor h (closed_sector hp (house x)).1) _ (fits_floor h hq)
  rw [← pol_mul, ← pol_mul, show house x * house x=1 by nth_rw 1 [← house_inv]; exact inv_mul_cancel _,pol_one] at hr
  exact hr

proof_context.conclusion: On the weight-four shell sector, bond G x 0 p q = bond G y 0 (reflectPol (house y * house x) p) q for nonzero x, y with |x| = |y|.
